# AI models

The commands `mt help` lists under AI models. More in [Models and model keys](../../../concepts/models-and-keys.md).

In a terminal, type `mt` and then the command. In the interactive shell and the cloud shell, type the command on
its own. `mt help <command>` shows the same details in your terminal.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`aimodel-list`](#aimodel-list) | List the AI models agents can run on, with their names and ids |

## aimodel-list

List the AI models agents can run on, with their names and ids.

```text
mt aimodel-list
```
